description: Was a hand-rolled config that re-implemented the org preset and diverged from it. Now it extends the preset like every other repo; what stays below is only what is genuinely specific to this repo, and each remaining key is a deliberate override of the preset.

Dropped as redundant: timezone, configMigration, osvVulnerabilityAlerts, rebaseWhen, vulnerabilityAlerts and the manager enable flags — the preset sets all of them, several to the same value. Also dropped the ':semanticCommitTypeAll(chore)' flattening, so commits now carry the estate's per-type feat/fix/chore like everywhere else.

packageRules.description: Laravel first-party packages move together. matchPackagePatterns is deprecated in Renovate, so this is restated as matchPackageNames globs.
